text: Lexical density of other users' counter-argument comments (source column OC_comments, a JSON list): content words (nouns, main/lexical verbs, adjectives, adverbs) divided by all words (content plus function words like articles, prepositions, pronouns, conjunctions, auxiliaries, determiners), as a 0–1 number estimated carefully. Words are pooled across all comments in the row (not averaged per comment; order irrelevant). Excluded before counting: text reporting OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, text reporting whether the outcome occurred, moderator/bot notices, and URLs/markup; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is kept as ordinary text. Returns null if the list is valid but empty, has no words after exclusions, or OC_comments is missing or malformed.
